```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library(daily)
```


```{r, results = 'asis', echo = FALSE}
daily2html(
  "daily.txt", 
  start = lubridate::mdy("01/10/2022"), 
  end   = lubridate::mdy("04/29/2022"), 
  show = 2:6, 
  items = c("Topic", "Read", "R", "Due", "Note")) |>
  cat()
```


```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
calendar("daily.txt", mask = c(2,4,6),
         start = lubridate::mdy("01/10/2022")) |>
  gg_calendar(show = 2:6) 
```
